component.name: Suite Start
component.summary: Install, open and update your Suite apps

description.p: Start is the Suite hub: it discovers the apps you have installed, opens their documents, routes suite:// links and asks Flatpak to install or update a deployment. The apps and their documents are ordinary files on your machine; there is no account and no suite-operated server.

Start never holds a document. It hands the path or bytes to the app that owns it, and it asks Flatpak to install, update or remove a deployment rather than writing the installation itself. A copy you place in a folder opens, reveals and forgets; Start does not replace it.
